own_solution.law: Terminal balance: m g = rho_L V g + 6 pi eta r v, so v = (m - rho_L (4/3) pi r^3) g / (6 pi eta r)
assumptions: V = (4/3) pi (2 mm)^3 = 3.351e-8 m^3; buoyant mass 4.222e-5 kg

TDB09.regime: Re = rho v d / eta < 1.4; here Re ~ 0.27 (0.39 with extra shot)

T66F4.regime: Re = rho v d / eta < 1.4; here Re ~ 0.27

notes: Base: m = 2.5e-4 kg, net mass 2.0778e-4 kg, net force 2.0362e-3 N, drag coefficient 6 pi eta r = 0.037699 N s/m, v = 0.05401 m/s. With extra 0.09 g: net mass 2.9778e-4 kg, v = 0.07741 m/s. Re checks pass. T3D94 and TEAB4 give 'a small amount' with no number while their apparent counterparts T9846 and TFAF0 state 0.09 g; if these are claimed minimal pairs that is a number difference, to be checked in pass 2. TFAF0/TEAB4 refer to an earlier release of the sphere, not the present one, so they do not affect this release (D). The 'it' in TFAF0/TEAB4 follows the float sentence but the float is not released, so the referent is the sphere.
